title.en: Journal of Education in Black Sea Region

scope.en: JEBS is a peer-reviewed international journal dedicated to publishing high-quality research in education. It strengthens the connection between research and practice at regional and global levels; articles from or dealing with Black Sea region countries are especially welcome, but authors worldwide are invited. All papers are double-blind refereed.

Journal in Humanities

scope.en: Journal in Humanities (JH) is an official scholarly, multidisciplinary and peer-reviewed indexed journal at IBSU, issued twice a year. It encourages contributions across the humanities — American and comparative literature, cultural and multicultural studies, gender studies, history, psychology, language, philosophy and geography — fostering a better understanding of the multidimensional nature of research.

Journal of Business

scope.en: The Journal of Business (JB) is an official scholarly, referred, multi-disciplinary and peer-reviewed scientific journal of the School of Business of International Black Sea University, issued twice a year (spring and fall). It publishes scholarly works in business management and administration — theoretical and practical issues of business activity, including cases of business experience. The aim is to analyse diverse issues and provide readers with new perspectives by publishing innovative, thought-provoking and analytical articles, bridging communities of scholars and business practitioners.
